title: 2 High-Yield Dividend ETFs to Buy to Generate Passive Income
description: The article discusses two dividend-focused ETFs - the Vanguard High Dividend Yield ETF (VYM) and the iShares Preferred and Income Securities ETF (PFF) - as options for generating passive income. The Vanguard ETF offers a steadily rising income stream, while the iShares ETF provides a higher-yielding, relatively fixed stream of passive income.

title: Will the Fed Cut Interest Rates Next Week? Here's What Wall Street Thinks.
description: The Federal Reserve has already cut interest rates twice since September, following a steady drop in the rate of inflation. The Fed appears likely to cut rates again next week, but expectations for further cuts in 2025 have fallen dramatically. Lower interest rates can be great for the stock market, but investors should be on the lookout for some economic weakness on the horizon.

title: Why Planet Labs Stock Is Gaining Altitude
